children: SIM Acquisition entered into a binding letter of intent to merge American Industrial Technologies with a newly formed SIM subsidiary, with AIT surviving as part of the combined company. At closing, SIM will issue approximately 50,000,000 common shares to AIT equity holders, adopt an employee stock plan up to 10% of fully diluted shares, and appoint AIT CEO John Chiorando as CEO and Chairman. Certain AIT holders will be locked up for 12 months. The LOI includes a $5 million termination fee under specified conditions, extends exclusivity through Dec. 31, 2026, and requires audited/reviewed financials by Nov. 15, 2026 and execution of definitive documents by Dec. 31, 2026.
: Binding letter of intent for business combination (merger)
: Pursue merger to form a combined public company
